proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ _ _ T
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := T.antilipschitz_of_injective_of_isClosed_range hi hc
    refine ⟨K + 1, by positivity, fun x => ?_⟩
    have h := hK.le_mul_dist x 0
    simp only [dist_zero_right, map_zero] at h
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖T x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, h⟩
    have hA : AntilipschitzWith ⟨c, hc.le⟩ T := T.antilipschitz_of_bound h
    exact ⟨hA.injective, hA.isClosed_range T.uniformContinuous⟩
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F] (T : E →L[𝕜] F), (Function.Injective T ∧ IsClosed (Set.range T)) ↔ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ c * ‖T x‖
